moments.frontstage: Status model (CONFIRMED_BANK, S971): RDO Deposit List Status column shows Open (Incomplete / Processing / Balanced / Jammed / Cancelled), Transmitting ('being sent to Bank of America'), Received ('successfully received by Bank of America'), Received Pending ('Do NOT rescan the deposit'), Perfected ('processed this deposit without making adjustments'), Perfected Adjusted ('processed this deposit and made adjustments').

moments.title: After Complete, 'The Deposit List screen displays and the status is…
moments.action: After Complete, 'The Deposit List screen displays and the status is updated as the deposit processes' (Transmitting -> Received -> Perfected / Perfected Adjusted); deposit also appears as a pending transaction in Online Banking; Deposit Details page can be printed. No confirmation number or confirmation email is documented.

moments.title: Deposits are subject to holds and RDO 'does not provide the ability to…
moments.action: Deposits are subject to holds and RDO 'does not provide the ability to verify funds at time of deposit'; limits 99 items per deposit and $999,999.99 per day; only one User ID (owner may assign a sub-user to deposit under it); endorsed checks must be retained 14 days then destroyed. Rejected-item handling (return reasons, re-presentment) is still not documented publicly.
moments.frontstage: Bank adjustments show as deposit status 'Perfected Adjusted' ('Bank of America processed this deposit and made adjustments'); Customer Adjustments reason codes define required action, e.g. 002 wrong declared amount (no action), 005 non-negotiable item / 018 IQA bad-quality image ('should be re-deposited through a channel other than Remote Deposit Online'), 701 improper endorsement ('Ensure endorsements are updated correctly and resubmit in Remote Deposit Online'). Returned items 'must be deposited inside a banking center'. Duplicate-flagged items not truly duplicate: deposit at banking center, Mobile or ATM. Delivery channel for adjustment notices not documented.

status_tracking.where: Remote Deposit Online 'Deposit List' screen (status updates as the deposit processes); deposit also shows as pending in Online Banking; Deposit Details printable

exceptions.customer_experience: Deposits subject to standard holds; no funds verification at capture; rejected-item notification path still not documented publicly.
exceptions.bank_handling: Hold/validation per Deposit Agreement; support via RDO servicing line 877-270-1242 (Mon–Fri 8–8 ET).
exceptions.resolution: Per Customer Adjustments reason code: resubmit in RDO (e.g., 701/702 endorsement), or re-deposit via another channel (005, 018); returned items only at a banking center

assessment: Contract terms are onerous for an SMB product.
